auxiliarySurfaces.currentBehavior: Every generated /tools/{toolId} route accepts unauthenticated loopback JSON/query arguments and returns raw tool results/errors.
GET /utcp returns the active-profile manual without authentication.
GET /build-info returns build provenance without authentication.
GET /debug-logs can return persisted raw arguments, results, and errors.
Permissive cors() precedes every route.
Global express.json 50 MiB parser runs before route-specific validation.
No global loopback/token/Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site/content-type/body guard exists.
UTCP_DEBUG appends raw request arguments and raw results/errors under ~/.utcp-debug/*.jsonl.
~/.utcp_config.json stores provider URLs and is rewritten non-atomically.
Editor.Profile stores active tool profile and response-envelope settings.
Console logs include paths, raw thrown errors, and per-tool failures.
All source/**/*.ts compiles into dist with inline source maps and inline sources.
Package includes all dist output and selected static/config files without a generated file allowlist witness.
Package includes dependency trees selected by directory names; transitive contents are not independently allowlisted.
Package includes static assets, panels, i18n, package metadata, and type declarations.
openDebugFolder shell-concatenates a platform command and invokes child_process.exec.
toggleDebug selects a method string and dispatches execute-scene-script dynamically.
runCode compiles caller-controlled JavaScript through new Function in the scene process.
Preview panel accepts a function-name string and forwards it through call-preview-function.
Debug menu toggles raw logging, opens its folder through a shell, and clears persisted raw logs.
Program URL fallback invokes cmd/open/xdg-open through child_process.execFile and is reachable from the removed programManage family.

none-v1.purpose: No upfront Creator state is required; any read occurs through the signed local primitive envelope.

scene-root-v1.purpose: Bind a scene-wide mutation to the exact open scene revision before the first write.

scene-target-v1.purpose: Bind a targeted node/component mutation to the exact entity revision and type before the first write.

ui-parent-v1.purpose: Bind UI construction to the selected parent and its scene revision before the first write.

animation-target-v1.purpose: Bind animation edits to the selected clip and current revision before the first write.

project-setting-v1.purpose: Bind a supported project-setting mutation to the current real Creator capability and setting revision.

editor-history-v1.purpose: Bind undo, redo, or snapshot abort to the current history head before changing it.

scene-lifecycle-v1.purpose: Bind scene open/save/save-as/close/reload to the current scene identity, dirty state, and revision.

build-task-v1.purpose: Bind build trigger/control to the current worker and task state before the external side effect.

editor-state-v1.purpose: Bind editor selection/viewport state before a local state transition.

runtime-state-v1.purpose: Bind preview runtime state before pause, resume, or time-scale transition.
